item: R6/T7: rows whose v1 node hash admits a rewrite that changes stored fields but no root
snapshot_set: the ten per-run window extracts in reproduce/snapshots (EXTRACTS_SHA256SUMS checked)

definitions.row_splice: ctx or par contains 0x7C: another (ctx', par') has the same v1 Row-scheme bytes
definitions.closure_splice: ctx, par or usr contains 0x7C: another (ctx', par', usr') has the same v1 Closure bytes
definitions.par_usr_splice: par or usr contains 0x7C: the parent/user boundary can move (the triage's case)
definitions.ctx_par_splice: ctx or par contains 0x7C: the context/parent boundary can move
definitions.user_erasable: usr not NULL and par_usr_splice: the user id can be replaced by an unresolvable value
definitions.null_alias_closure: some of ctx/par/usr is NULL: NULL <-> empty BLOB is invisible to v1
definitions.natural_alt_closure: the row's v1 bytes also parse as a different tuple whose BLOBs are all 0 or 16 bytes
definitions.unnatural: some context BLOB is non-NULL and not 16 bytes long
